author: HSinghHira
tagline: Free, private budgeting for New Zealand, built on Actual Budget.
description:
Trackie is a New Zealand-focused fork of Actual Budget, a fast, private, open-source budgeting app. This manifest self-hosts the same code that runs trackie.nz.

**Features**

- Your own private budget per person, created on first sign-in
- Passwordless sign-in through a bundled, self-hosted Logto server
- Optional end-to-end encryption you control, on top of Actual Budget
- Per-user NZ bank sync via Akahu, using each person's own tokens
- NZ defaults: DD/MM/YYYY dates, week starts Monday

**How to use?**

1. Finish the one-time Logto setup described in the install tips.
2. Open Trackie from the Zima OS dashboard.
3. Sign in with your email to create your private budget.
4. Link your bank under Settings if you want automatic transaction
   syncing.

5. Everything else is configured later from Settings inside Trackie,
   or the Logto admin console for sign-in settings.

tips.before_install:
1. Open the app configuration before starting the installation.

2. In the trackie service, find ACTUAL_OPENID_SERVER_HOSTNAME. Set
   it to the address you will use for Trackie, like
   http://192.168.1.50:8465.


3. In the logto service, find ENDPOINT. Set it to
   http://192.168.1.50:8466 (same host, port 8466).


4. In the logto service, find ADMIN_ENDPOINT. Set it to
   http://192.168.1.50:8467 (same host, port 8467).


5. In the trackie service, find ACTUAL_IDENTITY_SECRET and
   ACTUAL_AKAHU_TOKEN_SECRET. Replace both with your own random
   values from [randomkeygen.com](https://randomkeygen.com/).


6. Leave ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL, ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID, and
   ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET as they are for now. You will fill
   these in after step 10.


7. Start the Trackie installation and wait for all three
   containers to show as running.


8. Open the Logto admin console at your ADMIN_ENDPOINT address.

9. In the Logto console, go to Sign-in experience and turn on the
   email connector so login codes can be sent. If you skip this,
   set up an SMTP connector under Connectors first.


10. In the Logto console, go to Applications and add a new
    Traditional Web application called Trackie. Set its redirect
    URI to your SERVER_HOSTNAME plus /openid/callback, for example
    http://192.168.1.50:8465/openid/callback.


11. Copy the Application ID and Application Secret Logto shows
    you.


12. Go back to the app configuration. Set
    ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_ID and ACTUAL_OPENID_CLIENT_SECRET in the
    trackie service to the values from step 11.


13. Set ACTUAL_OPENID_DISCOVERY_URL in the trackie service to your
    ENDPOINT address plus /oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration,
    for example http://192.168.1.50:8466/oidc/.well-known/openid-configuration.


14. In the Logto console, go to Signing keys and rotate the key
    to RSA. Trackie will not be able to sign you in until this is
    done.


15. Restart the Trackie app so the new settings take effect.

16. Open Trackie from the Zima OS dashboard and sign in with your
    email to create your budget.


17. You can change bank sync, encryption, and other settings
    later from Settings inside Trackie, without reinstalling.

title: Trackie (Actual Budget - NZ Fork)
release_note:
- Initial version
- Bundles a self-hosted Logto server (pinned 1.37.1) plus its own
  Postgres, since Trackie requires an OIDC provider and enforces
  passwordless sign-in
